evidence.quote: Jens Larsson Co-founder, Partner & Portfolio Manager Jens is co-founder of St. Petri Capital and Portfolio Manager of St. Petri L/S. He was Chief Portfolio Manager of the thematic European Equity Absolute fund at Danske Capital (2007–2017), headed the European equity team at Nordea Investment Management (2004–2007) and was a founding partner of SEB Asset Management in Copenhagen. At Nordea Investment Management (1988–1998) he launched several European equity funds, including the first European small-cap fund in Denmark. Jens holds an M.Sc. in Economics from the University of Copenhagen.
